svg.text: PlasRisk: data-driven risk grading of bacterial plasmids for One Health surveillance
Any FASTA (plasmids, genomes, metagenomes, contigs) is scored on ten bounded sub-scores with data-driven weights, then assigned to five grades and validated in held-out and prospective cohorts.
full 10 dims · lite 5 dims · ordinal 8 terms
Five grades, mutually exclusive phenotype composition, grouped into three action tiers
Mutually exclusive phenotype share within grade
high-risk vehicles found in grades A/B
